name: Dr. Melih Can Korkmaz
desc:
Melih Can Korkmaz graduated as the valedictorian of Atatürk Anatolian High School.

Following his graduation from the Faculty of Law at Kadir Has University, he pursued his LL.M. studies at Freie Universität Berlin and subsequently completed his Ph.D. in Commercial Law at Marmara University.

Melih Can Korkmaz has served as Legal Counsel to various national and multinational companies and has advised clients on distributorship agreements between Middle Eastern and Turkish companies. He has extensive expertise in corporate law, capital markets law, international trade law, insurance law, energy law, competition law, personal data protection law, international arbitration, banking law, and intellectual property law.

He also possesses substantial experience in advising multinational corporations involved in international and large-scale infrastructure projects, particularly with respect to their cooperation and integration with domestic and international financial institutions, as well as the structuring and procurement of project financing.

Fluent in English, German, and Italian, Melih Can Korkmaz is also the author of numerous scholarly articles published in both Turkish and foreign languages in the field of Intellectual Property Law.

He is the author of the book Pre-emptive Rights in Joint Stock Companies (Anonim Ortaklıkta Rüçhan Hakkı).

In addition, he has extensive experience in matters relating to patents, trademarks, and industrial designs, and continues to provide legal counsel and advisory services in these areas.

In 2010, she further expanded her international legal experience through an internship at Moscardó & Stampa Abogados, a law firm affiliated with the Madrid Bar Association in Spain. During this period, she gained practical exposure to international legal practice, comparative legal systems, and cross-border transactions.

Following her return to Türkiye, she joined Zorlu Holding as In-House Legal Counsel, where she advised on a broad range of corporate and commercial matters, including corporate governance, commercial transactions, contract management, and general legal compliance. She subsequently established her own law practice, providing strategic legal counsel and dispute resolution services to both domestic and international clients across various sectors.

Since 2024, she has been serving as a Managing Partner at Momento Legal.

Her practice primarily focuses on corporate and commercial law, employment law, contract law, and corporate legal advisory services. She regularly advises domestic and international clients on day-to-day corporate legal matters, corporate structuring and governance, the drafting, review, and negotiation of complex commercial agreements, mergers and acquisitions, employment-related disputes, commercial litigation, and mediation proceedings.

She has extensive experience in providing practical, business-oriented legal solutions tailored to the commercial objectives of her clients. Her practice includes representing companies throughout all stages of commercial transactions and disputes, while delivering comprehensive legal support in both contentious and non-contentious matters.

She is fluent in English and provides legal services in both Turkish and English. She regularly assists international clients in cross-border matters and actively participates in the preparation, review, and negotiation of bilingual legal documentation and transactional agreements.

desc:
Between 2017 and 2021, Ahmet Kağan Altıngemi held various roles within AIESEC’s Compliance and Internal Audit function, serving successively as Team Member, Team Leader, Director, and Vice President. During this period, he was also actively involved in international social responsibility projects. In 2017, as part of the “Break the Barriers” project conducted in Kyiv, Ukraine, and Bucharest, Romania, he provided English language education to children. In 2018, he participated in the “Activate18” event in Egypt, where he delivered speeches and presentations on gender equality, human rights, and AIESEC’s role in career development.

Between 2021 and 2022, he worked at Bytelus Software Company, where he was involved in compliance, business development, and legal advisory processes, gaining experience in the legal and commercial operations of technology companies.

Altıngemi began his legal career as a trainee lawyer at MasterLaw+ Law Firm. Following his admission to the Bar, he continued at the firm as an attorney and subsequently assumed the position of Managing Attorney. During this period, he worked primarily in corporate law, commercial law, contract law, and information technology law, advising both domestic and international clients.

In 2024, he participated in the Eksim Pulse Acceleration Program, where he worked on matters relating to contracts and mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Alongside his legal career, Altıngemi further developed his technical expertise by completing a degree in Computer Programming at Anadolu University, graduating in 2025. He subsequently commenced an English-taught, thesis-based Master’s degree in European Union Law at Marmara University and is currently in the thesis stage of the program.

In 2026, combining his experience in law and technology with entrepreneurship, Altıngemi became a Co-Founder of Tebli, a legal technology company.

Altıngemi currently continues his legal practice as a Partner at Momento Legal, advising and representing domestic and international clients primarily in commercial and corporate law, information technology and technology law, contract law, and international commercial transactions.

name: Prof. Dr. Ali Yeşilırmak
desc:
Ali Yesilirmak is a professor at Ibn Haldun University School of Law and a visiting lecturer at the School of International Arbitration, CCLS, Queen Mary College, University of London. 

He has served as an arbitrator and counsel in many ad hoc and institutional arbitrations. He is a member of the Permanent Court of Arbitration and of the Court of Arbitration at the Istanbul Chamber of Commerce Arbitration Court (ITOTAM). He was an of counsel to Esin Attorney Partnership an affiliate of Baker & McKenzie Istanbul (2011-2014); and to Birsel Law Office 2001-2005. He was seconded to Herbert Smith London (2000-2001). Ali holds an LLB from Dokuz Eylul University, an LL.M. from the University of Texas at Austin and a Ph.D. from CCLS, Queen Mary, University of London. He was a member of the Committee attached to the Ministry of Justice and entrusted with the drafting the new Code of Civil Procedure (2011), of the Law on Conciliation in respect of Civil Matters (2011) and its Regulation (2012), and of the Law on Istanbul Arbitration Centre. He published various books and articles on arbitration, litigation, mediation, execution, and bankruptcy. He is a general editor on international dispute resolution series in which six books have been published in Turkish. He was awarded Schmitthoff scholarship; did internships at the International Chamber of Commerce and the American Arbitration Association, was a research assistant to HE Judge Professor Dr. Carl Baudenbacher of the EFTA Court. He is fluent in Turkish and English

name: Dr. Ömer Faruk Kafalı
desc:
Dr. Ömer-Faruk Kafali graduated from Istanbul Şehir University School of Law with an "Honorary Degree" in 2016. He completed the Master of Private Law Program at the Graduate School of Humanities and Social Sciences of İstanbul Şehir University with the thesis “Procedural Orders and Awards in Arbitration”. Dr. Kafali finished his Ph.D. in 2024 with the thesis “Party-Appointed Experts in International Arbitration: Impact on Proceedings, Problems and Solutions”.

Between 2017-2019, he worked as a Research Assistant at Istanbul Şehir University School of Law, Civil Procedural Law and Execution-Insolvency Law Department. Since October 2019, he has been working at Ibn Haldun University School of Law, at the Civil Procedural Law and Execution-Insolvency Law Department as an assistant Professor. Ömer Faruk Kafali is the Vice Director at the Dispute Resolution Centre and also the Erasmus Coordinator for the School of Law.  During 2022, Mr. Kafali was a visiting scholar at the Max Planck Institute for International Procedural Law (Luxembourg).

Dr. Kafali participated at the Willem C. Vis International Commercial Arbitration Moot Court Competition and FDI Foreign Direct Investment Moot Court Competition as a team member in 2015 and 2016. He also acted as an arbitrator at Willem C. Vis International Commercial Arbitration Moot Court Competition. Since 2017 he has been coaching various teams from different universities for national and international competitions. 

Dr. Kafali has authored several books and edited volumes on national and international arbitration, mediation and civil procedure. "Party-Appointed Experts in International Commercial and Investment Arbitration: Impact on Proceedings, Problems and Solutions” was published from Kluwer Law International and Juris World Arbitration Reporter Turkey Chapter.  He has also contributed numerous articles and book chapters on topics related to international arbitration, mediation and civil procedure.

In addition to his academic work, Dr. Kafali has extensive experience in dispute resolution, serving as a mediator, arbitrator, and secretary to arbitral tribunals in both national and international contexts. He is a member of several professional organizations, including the Chartered Institute of Arbitrators, OIC-AC and the International Chamber of Commerce Young Arbitrators Forum. 

He speaks German and Turkish (native), English (advanced) and French (beginner).

name: Laura Hlistei-Muresan
desc:
Laura Hlistei-Mureșan is a senior lawyer and legal executive admitted to the Romanian Bar, with more than 20 years of professional experience. Advising Romanian and international companies, financial institutions, and corporate groups, Laura combines her experience in private practice and in-house legal departments with particular expertise in regulated financial services, corporate and commercial law, real estate, litigation and disputes, debt recovery, GDPR and data protection, technology, and intellectual property.

Throughout her career in legal and compliance, she has gained extensive experience in coordinating cross-border legal matters, working with international law firms, negotiating complex commercial transactions, and managing external legal counsel. She currently serves as Head of Legal & Compliance and a member of the Executive Leadership Team at Flex Financial IFN S.A., where she manages the legal and compliance functions of a non-bank financial institution supervised by the National Bank of Romania. In this capacity, she advises senior management and the board on financial regulation, consumer credit, corporate governance, regulatory inspections, compliance processes, and business risks.

Laura’s expertise encompasses various legal aspects of financial services, including consumer credit, lending products and documentation, digital onboarding, electronic signatures, remote identification, data protection, and online distribution channels. She also has extensive experience in consumer-credit disputes, enforcement proceedings, debt-portfolio recovery, insolvency, and creditor representation.

Previously, Laura served as Legal Manager at KMG International / Rompetrol, where she managed legal matters relating to banking, arbitration, GDPR, commercial law, information technology, corporate law, oil and gas, and intellectual property. Among her notable matters, she provided legal representation to group companies in connection with a USD 360 million syndicated credit facility with UniCredit, ING, Raiffeisen, and BCR, including the negotiation, closing, and implementation of the transaction. In this capacity, she also managed the related security documentation, including mortgages over petroleum storage assets and security interests over bank accounts.

During her tenure at KMG International, she also led the implementation of GDPR across the group, supported the implementation of electronic signatures and electronic archiving systems, and provided legal support for major projects involving technology providers such as Microsoft, Oracle, SAP/Ariba, DocuSign, and Coupa. In addition, she managed KMGI’s Romanian, European Union, and international trademark portfolios, advising on trademark registrations and renewals, coexistence agreements, copyright, and other intellectual property matters. She also worked on legal matters relating to upstream oil and gas concessions, negotiations with ANRM, joint operating agreements, and international arbitration proceedings.

While serving as Senior Managing Associate at BCHLAW, Laura managed a team of approximately 10 lawyers, coordinated corporate and M&A projects, and was involved in various M&A transactions, including the sale of Cargus, a courier company. She also advised clients on company incorporations, corporate restructurings, Trade Registry procedures, commercial contracts, real estate, finance, and insolvency matters.

Laura also has significant experience in the real estate sector. At ONV Law, she worked on lease agreements relating to commercial premises in shopping centres and managed the negotiation of early termination and rent-reduction arrangements during the financial crisis, achieving significant cost savings for her clients. Earlier in her career, she represented clients in civil and commercial litigation, property restitution, insolvency, and debt-recovery proceedings. Among her notable matters was a high-value property restitution case concerning a property in central Bucharest with an approximate value of EUR 3 million.

Laura’s practice areas include Banking and Finance, Consumer Finance, Corporate and Commercial Law, Mergers and Acquisitions, Real Estate and Property Law, Litigation and Dispute Resolution, Insolvency and Debt Recovery, GDPR and Data Protection, Intellectual Property, Technology, Electronic Signatures and eIDAS, and Regulatory Law and Compliance.

A native Romanian speaker, Laura has advanced proficiency in English and working proficiency in French and Italian. She graduated from the University of Bucharest, Faculty of Law, and was admitted to the Bucharest Bar in 2005. In 2014, she completed a UK Contract Law Programme at St Catherine’s College, Oxford, and in February 2026, she completed the Mini MBA programme at the Bucharest International School of Management (BISM).

Practice Areas

Banking and Finance, Consumer Finance, Corporate and Commercial Law, Mergers and Acquisitions, Real Estate and Property Law, Litigation and Dispute Resolution, Insolvency and Debt Recovery, GDPR and Data Protection, Intellectual Property, Technology, Electronic Signatures and eIDAS, Regulatory Law and Compliance.

Languages

Romanian, English, French, and Italian.

name: Meriç  Çağlıaydın
desc:
Meriç Çağlıaydın Altınok is an internationally experienced corporate lawyer advising multinational corporations, international investors and senior executives on complex cross-border legal and commercial matters. Her practice focuses on corporate and commercial law, mergers and acquisitions, employment law, corporate governance, regulatory compliance and international business transactions, with extensive experience supporting companies operating across Europe, the Middle East and Türkiye.
She currently serves as Global Corporate Affairs Manager and Corporate Legal Counsel at Transitex Portugal, where she advises executive management on corporate governance, regulatory compliance, institutional relations and strategic legal matters. Working closely with the Chief Executive Officer and international legal teams, she leads the review and negotiation of domestic and cross-border commercial agreements, monitors regulatory developments affecting the business and supports high-level corporate decision-making across multiple jurisdictions.
Prior to joining Transitex, Meriç advised international clients in Portugal on immigration and real estate investments, acting as the principal legal liaison between foreign investors and Portuguese legal professionals. Her work involved coordinating complex cross-border transactions, negotiating property acquisition documentation and managing multi-jurisdictional client relationships from inception through completion.
Before relocating to Portugal, Meriç built an extensive in-house legal career with leading multinational organisations. As Corporate Legal Counsel at ISS Turkey, she advised on sophisticated commercial contracts, procurement, employment law, public tenders, data protection and corporate compliance matters while partnering closely with commercial, operational and executive teams on strategic projects. Her role included identifying legal and commercial risks, supporting contract negotiations and ensuring that contractual frameworks reflected both business objectives and corporate governance standards.
Earlier in her career, she was a member of the executive team at Cleanzy Group, where she supported the company’s international expansion strategy across multiple European jurisdictions. She advised on commercial contracts, employment matters, cross-border legal operations and regulatory issues while coordinating legal work with external counsel in the United Kingdom, Spain, Italy and Türkiye.
Meriç also gained significant private practice experience at internationally recognised law firms, including DWF Turkey, AK Law Firm, Aksan Law Firm, SunEdison Turkey and Esin Attorney Partnership, a member firm of Baker McKenzie International. During this period, she advised domestic and international clients on mergers and acquisitions, venture capital investments, banking and finance, renewable energy projects, corporate restructurings, foreign direct investment, employment law and complex commercial transactions. Her experience spans both transactional work and ongoing legal advisory services for multinational enterprises operating in highly regulated industries.
Meriç holds a Master of Laws (LL.M.) from the University of New South Wales, Sydney, where she specialised in International Law and Human Rights & Social Justice. During her postgraduate studies she received the International High Achiever Scholarship, was named to the Dean’s Honour List for Academic Excellence and was awarded the highest mark for her research on international child labour. She earned her Bachelor of Laws from Bahçeşehir University, graduating with High Honours while receiving academic scholarships throughout her legal education.
She is fluent in English and Turkish and has working proficiency in Portuguese, enabling her to advise clients on cross-border matters involving multiple legal systems and international stakeholders. Her combination of private practice and multinational in-house experience allows her to deliver commercially focused, pragmatic and solution-oriented legal advice tailored to the needs of global businesses.

Commercial Law, Corporate Law, Labor Law, Inheritance Law, Divorce – Family, Real Estate Law, Criminal Law, Art Law, Personal Injury Law, Insurance Law, Administrative Law.

She speaks French, German and English.
